svg.title: EcoRefill activity diagram
svg.desc: Alternative recycling and water refill activities, including reward claiming, optional owner-approved point purchases, request validation, and dispenser failure handling.
svg.text: Press blue button or select Refill Water
Accepted items require supported material, detection checks, and a stable weight of 300 g or less. Visual checks apply when enforced.
Refill QR: 5 minutes while waiting. Purchases may remain pending or be rejected without a point transfer. See companion notes for persistence limits.
A valid reward claim requires authentication and an available, unclaimed QR reward within its 60-second validity period.
